Pictor demo

Fifteen of Recharts' own examples (recharts.org), each drawn three times from the same data: by Recharts 2.15.4 in Chromium after mount (the reference), by Pictor on the web (the markup Aioros writes per request, live on this page: hover a chart) and by Pictor on the desktop (Avalonia and Skia). Text is Inter at 14 px on every side. No script runs on this page.

Pictor: .NET 10.0.12, commit ef3b9ca, 2026-10-15 10:08 UTC, Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-14700, 4 threads, load 3.29. Recharts: Node v22.20.0, React 18.3.1, Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-14700, 28 threads; Chromium 153.0.8010.12. A run on a loaded workstation shows trends; the lab runner's runs are in docs/benchmarks.md.

Summary

Structure: Pictor's markup against Recharts', element by element (no difference above 0.01 px is a match). Pixels: share of inked pixels that differ by more than 64 in a channel from Recharts' screenshot. Server: Pictor writing the chart (layout and markup) against Recharts' renderToStaticMarkup. Chromium: showing Pictor's markup against React mounting Recharts. Bytes: the chart's markup, raw and brotli; Recharts' figure is its server markup, and its interactivity also needs its script.
